questions.q: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
questions.why: Прогноз за тим, що бачимо зараз (хмари), — *be going to*: *It is going to rain.*

questions.q: We ___ her tomorrow at 5; we've arranged it.
questions.why: Домовленість на конкретний час (*we've arranged it*) — Present Continuous: *We are visiting her tomorrow at 5.*

questions.q: The train ___ at 9:15 tomorrow.
questions.why: Розклад транспорту — Present Simple: *The train leaves at 9:15 tomorrow.*

questions.q: "The phone is ringing." — "I ___ it."
questions.why: Рішення, прийняте в момент мовлення (телефон дзвонить просто зараз), — *will*: *I'll answer it.*

questions.q: I promise I ___ (not / tell) anyone.
questions.why: Обіцянка — *will*: *I promise I won't tell anyone.*

questions.q: In June I ___ here for five years.
questions.why: До певного моменту в майбутньому (*In June*) я пропрацюю п'ять років — Future Perfect: *will have worked*.

questions.q: This time tomorrow I ___ (fly) to Rome.
questions.why: *This time tomorrow* — процес у конкретний момент майбутнього, Future Continuous: *will be flying*.

questions.q: I ___ visit my grandmother this weekend. I've already decided.
questions.why: Рішення прийняли заздалегідь (*I've already decided*) — *be going to*: *I am going to visit my grandmother.*

questions.q: ___ we go to the cinema?
questions.why: Пропозиція зробити щось разом — *Shall we…?*: *Shall we go to the cinema?*

answer: He is going to have a day off tomorrow
Tomorrow he is going to have a day off
questions.why: Особистий план — *be going to*: *He is going to have a day off tomorrow.*

questions.q: The concert ___ (start) at 8 pm. It's on the ticket.
questions.why: Подія за розкладом (на квитку) — Present Simple: *The concert starts at 8 pm.*

questions.q: I ___ (meet) Anna for lunch tomorrow. We've booked a table.
questions.why: Домовленість (столик заброньовано) — Present Continuous: *I am meeting Anna.* *am going to meet* (план) теж правильне.

questions.q: Watch out! You ___ (fall)!
questions.why: Бачимо, що зараз станеться, — *be going to*: *You're going to fall!* Як вигук-попередження можна і *You'll fall!*

questions.q: I think it ___ (be) a great party.
questions.why: Думка про майбутнє з *I think* — найчастіше *will*: *I think it will be a great party.* *is going to be* теж правильно.

questions.q: "I'm cold." — "I ___ (close) the window."
questions.why: Рішення в момент мовлення (відповідь на *I'm cold*) — *will*: *I'll close the window.*

questions.q: My flight ___ at 6 am.
questions.why: Розклад рейсу — Present Simple: *My flight leaves at 6 am.*

questions.q: I've decided. I ___ learn to drive this year.
questions.why: Рішення, прийняте раніше (*I've decided*), — *be going to*: *I am going to learn to drive.*

questions.q: Maybe I ___ visit you next summer.
questions.why: Невпевнене припущення з *Maybe* — *will*: *Maybe I'll visit you.*

questions.q: What ___ this evening? Any plans?
questions.why: Питання про плани на сьогодні — Present Continuous: *What are you doing this evening?*

answer: We are flying to Rome on Friday
On Friday we are flying to Rome
questions.why: Домовленість (квитки є) — Present Continuous: *We are flying to Rome on Friday.*
questions.hint: У п'ятницю ми летимо до Рима.

questions.why: Думка-прогноз з *I think* — *will*: *I think she will win.*

answer: It is going to rain soon
Soon it is going to rain
questions.why: Прогноз за ознаками — *be going to*: *It is going to rain soon.*

questions.q: Look at the score! They ___ win.
questions.why: Рахунок уже показує, що буде, — *be going to*: *They are going to win.*

questions.q: I think you ___ this book.
questions.why: Прогноз-думка з *I think* — *will*: *I think you'll like this book.* *like* у Continuous не вживають.

questions.q: She ___ to sell her car.
questions.why: Заперечення — *isn't going to* + дієслово: *She isn't going to sell her car.*

questions.q: ___ you going to tell him the truth?
questions.why: Питання з *going to*: *Are* + підмет + *going to*: *Are you going to tell him?*

questions.q: I'll text you when I ___ (arrive).
questions.why: Після *when* у значенні майбутнього — Present Simple: *when I arrive*, не *when I will arrive*.
